summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corp filed an 8-K on May 22, 2026, reporting the issuance of 3,277,438 shares of Class A common stock in satisfaction of contingent earn-out obligations under a 2021 business combination agreement. The shares were issued to former stockholders of Legacy Navitas based on stock price targets achieved before October 19, 2026. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine contractual issuance, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle exists as there is no merger, tender, or restructuring event.
